verdict.rationale: A probe confirms a live llms.txt (HTTP 200) at developer.clickup.com with a ClickUp Documentation index, and the developer docs are served as markdown (.md) pages that an agent can ingest directly. The raw OpenAPI spec is also documented as available per API version, though the standard probe paths returned 404. Missing for 10: evidence of how deep or complete the llms.txt index is (only its header is shown), an llms-full.txt or similar full-content bundle, and independent or community corroboration of agents using these docs.
